definitions.gloss: individual instruction; private tutoring; one-on-one guidance
definitions.explanation: Teaching or guidance tailored to an individual student, as opposed to group instruction. Very common in the Japanese education system, especially at cram schools.

examples.japanese: {個別|こべつ}{指導|しどう}の{塾|じゅく}に{通|かよ}っている。
examples.english: I attend a cram school with individual instruction.

examples.japanese: {個別|こべつ}{指導|しどう}なら{自分|じぶん}のペースで{学|まな}べる。
examples.english: With individual instruction, you can learn at your own pace.

examples.japanese: {苦手|にがて}な{科目|かもく}は{個別|こべつ}{指導|しどう}で{集中的|しゅうちゅうてき}に{学|まな}んだほうが{効果的|こうかてき}だ。
examples.english: For weak subjects, it is more effective to study intensively with individual tutoring.

notes:
USAGE:
Very common in the Japanese education industry, especially in advertisements for {塾|じゅく} (cram schools). Many cram schools specifically brand themselves as {個別|こべつ}{指導|しどう}{塾|じゅく} to distinguish from group-based instruction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {個別|こべつ}{指導|しどう}{塾|じゅく} (individual tutoring cram school)
- {個別|こべつ}{指導|しどう}を{受|う}ける (to receive individual instruction)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {家庭|かてい}{教師|きょうし}: private tutor — a person, not a system of instruction
- {集団|しゅうだん}{指導|しどう}: group instruction — the opposite approach
